subject: Vendor initiation: data corrections, duplicate check & bank verification
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: procure_ops@acme-corp.com, Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor initiation: data corrections, duplicate check & bank verification

Hi Daniel / Acme procurement team,

Thanks for agreeing to start the onboarding for Acme Supplies. To get your vendor record live and enable PO issuance we need a couple of quick items from you and to resolve a possible duplicate in our vendor master. Please see the checklist and requested artifacts below: 

Mandatory items (please return by EOD Thu Jul 3):
- Completed Vendor Onboarding Form (attached)
- Completed Banking Authorization (attached) OR DocuSign link below for bank verification
- Current W-9 (if US entity) or local tax form
- Confirmation of legal entity name + preferred remit address and invoice email (we will send POs to the remit address)

Possible duplicate: our search returned two similar supplier rows: 
- "Acme Supplies Inc." (internal candidate ID: SUP-00876)
- "Acme Supply, LLC" (internal candidate ID: SUP-03112)

If you own both entries please confirm the canonical legal name you want us to keep and which supplier ID we should merge/close.

PO and payments notes:
- Once vendor is validated we will create a live supplier ID and issue POs to billing@acme-corp.com.
- Standard payment terms on our side: Net 45 (Finance will confirm final terms).

DocuSign bank auth: https://www.docusign.com/agree/abc123-bank-auth
Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_ACME.docx, Banking_Authorization_ACME.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Vendor Programs (Procurement Ops)
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0183

From: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@acme-corp.com>

Hi Hannah / team,

Thanks — we found the two records you mentioned. Quick context: Acme Supply, LLC is the legal operating company (Tax ID: 12-3456789) and Acme Supplies Inc. is an older purchasing alias that some of our legacy vendors still use. Please keep Acme Supply, LLC as canonical.

I've attached our corporate registration and a current W-9. I will also start the DocuSign flow for the banking authorization now.

Attachments: Acme_Corp_Registration.pdf, W9_Acme.pdf

Let me know if you need anything else.

—Daniel

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:22:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor initiation: data corrections, duplicate check & bank verification

Thanks Daniel — that helps. Hannah / Marcus, please proceed as follows: 

1) Merge the legacy alias (SUP-00876) into the canonical record SUP-03112. Keep legal name as "Acme Supply, LLC" and add the legacy alias to the vendor notes for future matching.
2) Validate the Tax ID from the registration and W-9 (KYC step).
3) Once DocuSign completes for the banking authorization, Finance (Laura) to validate routing + masked acct digits.
4) Create SUP ticket and tag AP so POs flow to billing@acme-corp.com.

Marcus — can you own the master file merge and create the SUP ticket (include snapshot of both records)? Hannah, please track the DocuSign completion and ping Laura for bank validation.

Karthik
Head of Procurement Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 13:30:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor initiation: data corrections, duplicate check & bank verification

Following up — I created the SUP ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4221 and attached a CSV export of both vendor rows for Marcus. Marcus — please merge into SUP-03112 and add alias SUP-00876 to the notes.

Daniel — I see the DocuSign bank auth has been started but not yet completed. For speed, you can either:
- Finish the DocuSign flow (preferred), or
- Send a signed PDF of the Banking_Authorization with a bank statement (redact sensitive digits) to ap@redwood.com

I attached a copy of the Banking_Authorization_ACME.pdf (for reference) and the Vendor_Onboarding_Form_ACME.docx that we need completed for tax/PO routing.

Next steps summary: 
- Marcus: merge records + update vendor master (target: EOD Tue Jul 1)
- Daniel: complete DocuSign or provide signed bank docs (target: EOD Thu Jul 3)
- Laura: validate W-9 + masked bank digits once received

Thanks all — I will update the SUP ticket as things move.

Best,
Hannah

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:02:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor initiation: data corrections, duplicate check & bank verification

Got the W-9 (thanks Daniel). Quick finance notes: 
- Please do not send full bank account numbers in email — only masked digits (e.g., ****1234). If you share a statement for verification, redact account numbers but include bank name and routing number separately via the secure DocuSign or the secure AP upload link.
- We will validate the Tax ID and mark SUP-03112 as verified in the vendor master once we confirm the DocuSign / bank docs.
- Confirmed payment terms: Net 45, invoices to be emailed to ap@redwood.com with the PO number in the subject.

Marcus — once you finalize the merge, please assign the supplier code ACME-023 and notify AP to accept POs.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
